arxiv-2011-07751.title: Tucker decomposition-based Temporal Knowledge Graph Completion Journal: Neurocomputing
arxiv-2011-07751.creator: Pengpeng Shao 1 , Guohua Yang 1 , Dawei Zhang 1 , Jianhua Tao 1,2 , Feihu Che 1 , Tong Liu 1
arxiv-2011-07751.description: Abstract Knowledge graphs have been demonstrated to be an effective tool for numerous intelligent applications. However, a large amount of valuable knowledge still exists implicitly in the knowledge graphs. To enrich the existing knowledge graphs, recent years witness that many algorithms for link prediction and knowledge graphs embedding have been designed to infer new facts.

arxiv-2209-10790.title: A strong shock during a nova outburst: an origin of multiple velocity systems in optical spectra and of high-energy emissions
arxiv-2209-10790.creator: Izumi Hachisu, Mariko Kato
arxiv-2209-10790.description: Abstract We propose a theoretical explanation of absorption/emission line systems in classical novae based on a fully self-consistent nova explosion model. We found that a reverse shock is formed far outside the photosphere ( ≳ 10 13 \gtrsim 10^{13} cm) because later-ejected mass with a faster velocity collides with earlier-ejected matter.

arxiv-2212-08427.title: WebAssembly Diversification for Malware Evasion
arxiv-2212-08427.creator: Javier Cabrera-Arteaga, Martin Monperrus, Tim Toady, Benoit Baudry
arxiv-2212-08427.description: Abstract \revision WebAssembly has become a crucial part of the modern web, offering a faster alternative to JavaScript in browsers. While boosting rich applications in browser, this technology is also very efficient to develop cryptojacking malware. This has triggered the development of several methods to detect cryptojacking malware.

arxiv-2307-14447.title: Tunable Magnon-Photon Coupling by Magnon Band Gap in a Layered Hybrid Perovskite Antiferromagnet
arxiv-2307-14447.creator: Yi Li, Timothy Draher, Andrew H. Comstock, Yuzan Xiong, Md Azimul Haque, Elham Easy, Jiang-Chao Qian, Tomas Polakovic, John E. Pearson, Ralu Divan, Jian-Min Zuo, Xian Zhang, Ulrich Welp, Wai-Kwong Kwok, Axel Hoffmann, Joseph M. Luther, Matthew C. Beard, Dali Sun, Wei Zhang, Valentine Novosad
arxiv-2307-14447.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yi Li, Timothy Draher, Andrew H. Comstock, Yuzan Xiong, Md Azimul Haque, Elham Easy, Jiang-Chao Qian, Tomas Polakovic, John E. Pearson, Ralu Divan, Jian-Min Zuo, Xian Zhang, Ulrich Welp, Wai-Kwong Kwok, Axel Hoffmann, Joseph M. Luther, Matthew C. Beard, Dali Sun, Wei Zhang, Valentine Novosad. Tunability of coherent coupling between fundamental excitations is an important prerequisite for expanding their functionality in hybrid quantum systems. In hybrid magnonics, the dipolar interaction between magnon and photon usually persists and cannot be switched off.

arxiv-2401-06085.title: On the stabilizer of the graph of linear functions over finite fields
arxiv-2401-06085.creator: Valentino Smaldore, Corrado Zanella, Ferdinando Zullo
arxiv-2401-06085.description: Abstract In this paper we will study the action of 𝔽 q n 2 × 2 \mathbb{F}_{q^{n}}^{2\times 2} on the graph of an 𝔽 q {{\mathbb{F}}_{q}} -linear function of 𝔽 q n {{\mathbb{F}}_{q^{n}}} into itself. In particular we will see that, under certain combinatorial assumptions, its stabilizer (together with the sum and product of matrices) is a field.

arxiv-2405-00090.title: Accelerated cosmic expansion, mass creation, and the QCD axion
arxiv-2405-00090.creator: Kristjan Müürsepp, Enrico Nardi, Clemente Smarra
arxiv-2405-00090.description: Abstract We propose a mechanism in which the current acceleration of cosmic expansion is driven by continuous creation of energy density ρ b \rho_{b} for a certain field φ b \varphi_{b} . We accordingly modify Einstein’s equation, derive modified Friedmann equations and analyze the regimes in which cosmic acceleration occurs.

arxiv-2406-00857.title: Modeling the refractive index profile n(z) of polar ice for ultra-high energy neutrino experiments
arxiv-2406-00857.creator: S. Ali, P. Allison, S. Archambault, J.J. Beatty, D.Z. Besson, A. Bishop, P. Chen, Y.C. Chen, B.A. Clark, W. Clay, A. Connolly, K. Couberly, L. Cremonesi, A. Cummings, P. Dasgupta, R. Debolt, S. de Kockere, K.D. de Vries, C. Deaconu, M. A. DuVernois, J. Flaherty, E. Friedman, R. Gaior, P. Giri, J. Ha
arxiv-2406-00857.description: Abstract We have developed an in-situ index of refraction profile n(z) for cold polar ice, using the transit times of radio signals broadcast from an englacial transmitter to 2-5 km distant radio-frequency receivers, deployed at depths up to 200 m.

arxiv-2410-14567.title: ELOQ: Resources for Enhancing LLM Detection of Out-of-Scope Questions CCS: Computing methodologies Natural language processing CCS: Information systems Question answering
arxiv-2410-14567.creator: Zhiyuan Peng, Jinming Nian, Alexandre Evfimievski, Yi Fang
arxiv-2410-14567.description: Abstract . Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has become integral to large language models (LLMs), particularly for conversational AI systems where user questions may reference knowledge beyond the LLMs’ training cutoff. However, many natural user questions lack well-defined answers, either due to limited domain knowledge or because the retrieval system returns documents that are relevant in appearance but uninformative in content.

arxiv-2411-17071.title: Fast, Precise Thompson Sampling for Bayesian Optimization
arxiv-2411-17071.creator: David Sweet
arxiv-2411-17071.description: Abstract Thompson sampling (TS) has optimal regret and excellent empirical performance in multi-armed bandit problems. Yet, in Bayesian optimization, TS underperforms popular acquisition functions (e.g., EI, UCB). TS samples arms according to the probability that they are optimal. A recent algorithm, P-Star Sampler (PSS), performs such a sampling via Hit-and-Run. We present an improved version, Stagger Thompson Sampler (STS).

arxiv-2412-19720.title: Sharpening Neural Implicit Functions with Frequency Consolidation Priors
arxiv-2412-19720.creator: Chao Chen, Yu-Shen Liu, Zhizhong Han
arxiv-2412-19720.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chao Chen, Yu-Shen Liu, Zhizhong Han. Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) are vital implicit representations to represent high fidelity 3D surfaces. Current methods mainly leverage a neural network to learn an SDF from various supervisions including signed distances, 3D point clouds, or multi-view images.

arxiv-2503-19437.title: Two-photon Transition Form Factor of η c , b ​ ( n ​ S ) \eta_{c,b}(nS) and χ c ​ 0 , b ​ 0 ​ ( n ​ P ) \chi_{c0,b0}(nP) via Relativized Mock Meson States
arxiv-2503-19437.creator: Tian-Cheng Ding, Jian Huang, Muyang Chen
arxiv-2503-19437.description: Abstract We construct relativized mock meson states for heavy quarkonium, where the Dirac spinors import kinetic relativistic correction and the dynamic wave functions are the same as those solved from the Schrödinger equation. We find that the relativistic correction imported by Dirac spinors is crucial to study the two-photon transition form factors.

arxiv-2504-10662.title: Emotion Alignment: Discovering the Gap Between Social Media and Real-World Sentiments in Persian Tweets and Images
arxiv-2504-10662.creator: Sina Elahimanesh, Mohammadali Mohammadkhani, Shohreh Kasaei
arxiv-2504-10662.description: Abstract In contemporary society, widespread social media usage is evident in people’s daily lives. Nevertheless, disparities in emotional expressions between the real world and online platforms can manifest. We comprehensively analyzed Persian community on X to explore this phenomenon. An innovative pipeline was designed to measure the similarity between emotions in the real world compared to social media.

arxiv-2604-10614.creator: Andrea Bondesan, Jacopo Borsotti, Mattia Fontana

corneille-polyeucte-constable-1909.title: Polyeucte
corneille-polyeucte-constable-1909.creator: Pierre Corneille, trans. Thomas Constable
corneille-polyeucte-constable-1909.description: Corneille's Christian tragedy of the Armenian martyr Polyeuctus — the summit of French classical tragedy's religious strain, in Thomas Constable's Harvard Classics translation. Joins the library's Le Cid.

pmc-11440775.title: An isolated mesenteric hematoma following blunt abdominal trauma - case report and literature review
pmc-11440775.creator: Kimihiro Yonemitsu, Yasuhiko Fujita, Teruyoshi Amagai
pmc-11440775.description: significant issue with bowel injury from blunt abdominal trauma is bowel perforation, with a reported prevalence of 5 % and a mortality rate as high as 17.5 % [3]. Furthermore, a literature review of mesenteric hematoma revealed 20 cases for the last a quarter of century. The details are described in discussion part.

pmc-11479762.title: Kin recognition for incest avoidance in Damaraland mole-rats, Fukomys damarensis
pmc-11479762.creator: Amy E. Leedale, Philippe Vullioud, David Seager, Markus Zöttl, Gaétan Glauser, Tim Clutton-Brock
pmc-11479762.description: Across taxa, breeding among close relatives is usually avoided because it incurs fitness costs to offspring. Incest is often averted through the dispersal of either sex from the natal area to breed. In some philopatric species, association among relatives extends into adulthood, and an ability to discriminate kin may be required for individuals to reduce inbreeding risk.

pmc-11673942.title: Extracellular Vesicles from Mesenchymal Stem Cells: Potential as Therapeutics in Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD)
pmc-11673942.creator: Xue Zou, David Brigstock, Nuria Morral
pmc-11673942.description: Background/Objectives: Metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is characterized by the accumulation of triglycerides within hepatocytes, which can progress to more severe conditions, such as metabolic dysfunction-associated steatohepatitis (MASH), which may include progressive fibrosis, leading to cirrhosis, cancer, and death.

pmc-12438616.title: Regulation of the Subjective Experience of Safety in Humor among Younger Schoolchildren
pmc-12438616.creator: A Akhmetzyanova, T Artemyeva, I Artemyeva
pmc-12438616.description: IntroductionLaughter can be regarded as a distinct form of cathartic experience, arising from the violation of various well-established cultural norms. The balance between the emotions of laughter and fear depends on the extent and nature of the norm violation, as well as the specifics of its perception.

pmc-12478281.title: Efficacy of precisely tailored phage cocktails targeting carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii reveals evolutionary trade-offs: a proof-of-concept study
pmc-12478281.creator: Ziqiang Liu, Xin Tan, Min Xiong, Shitong Lu, Yongqing Yang, Heng Zhu, Jieqiong Zhang, Xiangying Luo, Caiyun Zhou, Shujiang Wei, Ning Zhou, Xueyan Liu, Changqing Bai, Yongjun Pan, Yingfei Ma
pmc-12478281.description: SummaryBackgroundThe rapid emergence of phage-resistant bacterial mutants and the challenge of developing tailored phage cocktails have significantly hindered the broad application of phage therapy. This is particularly critical for infections caused by highly prevalent strains such as capsule locus 2 (KL2)-type carbapenem-resistant Acinetobacter baumannii (CRAB) in China.

pmc-12659127.title: Bee sting-induced myocardial infarction: a systematic review with illustrative case
pmc-12659127.creator: Ziad W. Elmezayen, Alaa Zayed, Asmaa Sarama, Enas Samara, Moaath Sawalha
pmc-12659127.description: ObjectiveTo systematically review and analyze published case reports and case series describing myocardial infarction following bee stings, with a focus on identifying patterns in clinical presentation, diagnostic findings, and management strategies associated with Kounis Syndrome.MethodsThis manuscript has a dual structure: a systematic review of published case reports and a concise representative case from our institution.

pmc-12749594.title: Parkinson’s disease-associated alterations in DNA methylation and hydroxymethylation in human brain
pmc-12749594.creator: Juliana I. Choza, Mahek Virani, Nathan C. Kuhn, Marie Adams, Joseph Kochmanski, Alison I. Bernstein
pmc-12749594.description: Epigenetic mechanisms mediate interactions between aging, genetics, and environmental factors in sporadic Parkinson’s disease (PD). While multiple studies have explored DNA modifications in PD, few focus on 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmc), which is important in the central nervous system and sensitive to environmental exposures. Existing studies have not differentiated between 5-methylcytosine (5mc) and 5hmc or have analyzed them separately.

pmc-13163373.title: Piezo2-Initiated Ultrafast Signaling and Its Acquired Channelopathy in Light of Quantum Gravity Theory
pmc-13163373.creator: Balázs Sonkodi
pmc-13163373.description: Big Bang theories are connected to gravity by force of attraction. Forced lengthening, like eccentric contractions, instigate proprioception as a result of working against gravity. Piezo2, as the principal mechanosensory ion channel responsible for proprioception, is theorized to fine-modulate these anti-gravitational contractions in order to provide system-wide ultrafast postural control.

pmc-13284537.title: Laboratory-based Surveillance to Sustain Measles Elimination in the Republic of Korea
pmc-13284537.creator: Su Jin Kim, Eun-Ji Choi, BooMi La, Deog-Yong Lee, Heui Man Kim, Hyuk Chu, 수진 김, 은지 최, 부미 라, 덕용 이, 희만 김, 혁 주
pmc-13284537.description: ObjectivesTo describe the operation of a laboratory-based measles surveillance system required to sustain measles elimination and to provide directions to reinforce molecular surveillance.MethodsThe study used a case-based surveillance system linked to the mandatory reporting of suspected measles cases. It employed measles-specific antibody testing and real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction for laboratory confirmation, enabling differentiation between wild-type and vaccine-associated cases.

pmc-13305524.title: The Grieving Process of a Family Caregiver: Experience Before Influences What Happens Next—A Grounded Theory
pmc-13305524.creator: Catarina Simões, Margarida Vieira, Ana Paula Sapeta

pmc-13355499.title: Assessing the characteristics of MEMS stations for ground-motion recording: A case study of the 2023 Ms6.2 jishishan earthquake, China
pmc-13355499.creator: Peibin Xu, Hongwei Wang
pmc-13355499.description: SummaryChina established the National Earthquake Intensity Rapid Reporting and Early Warning System (NEIR&EWS) in 2024. The system incorporates a force-balance accelerometer (FBA) and micro-electro-mechanical systems (MEMS) stations. This study systematically evaluated the differences in ground motion intensity measures (IMs) between MEMS and FBA stations using the 2023 Jishishan earthquake as a case study.

pmc-13357743.title: Restoration of axon initial segment plasticity via chemogenetic activation rescues autism-related behaviors
pmc-13357743.creator: Yoshinori Otani, Xiaowei Zhu, Xinlang Liu, Kohei Koga, Ryo Kawabata, Hisao Miyajima, Toru Takumi, Masashi Fujitani
pmc-13357743.description: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) presents a major clinical challenge, necessitating the identification of novel therapeutic targets rooted in its underlying pathophysiology. The axon initial segment (AIS) is the critical site for action potential initiation and a hub for homeostatic plasticity; however, its involvement in ASD remains poorly defined.

pmc-13395569.title: 1‐Aryl‐6,7‐Dimethoxy‐3,4‐Dihydroisoquinoline‐2(1H)‐Sulfonamides as hCA XII Selective Inhibitors: Experimental and Theoretical Studies to Interrogate the Isoform Selectivity
pmc-13395569.creator: Federico Ricci, Anna Di Fiore, Andrea Angeli, Laura De Luca, Francesca Mancuso, Davide Esposito, Giuseppina De Simone, Claudiu T. Supuran, Rosaria Gitto
pmc-13395569.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Human carbonic anhydrase XII (hCA XII) represents an important pharmacological target for different types of cancer. hCA XII plays a crucial role in regulating both extracellular and intracellular pH, thereby influencing cancer cell proliferation, invasion, growth, and metastasis. Although the interaction features of hCA inhibitors (hCAIs) with the catalytic site of distinct hCA isoforms are generally well described, the lack of selectivity remains a major challenge.

pmc-13481587.title: Cystic burden meets blood pressure: cardiac remodelling in paediatric autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease
pmc-13481587.creator: Camille Heming, Emily Haseler, Alexandra Savis, Hannah Samuel, John M Simpson, Manish D Sinha
pmc-13481587.description: BackgroundWe evaluated the prevalence and phenotype of hypertension in untreated children with autosomal dominant polycystic kidney disease (ADPKD) and examined associations with blood pressure (BP), cyst burden, and left ventricular (LV) structure and function.MethodsSingle-centre, cross-sectional study included children and young people (< 18 years) with ADPKD.

pmc-13504240.title: Sulforaphane‐Producing Lacticaseibacillus paracasei CCFM1221 Combining Broccoli Seed Extract Improved the Hepatoprotective Effect on Lipopolysaccharide‐Treated Mice
pmc-13504240.creator: Xin Tang, Yi Wei, Weiling Guo, Qiuxiang Zhang, Jianxin Zhao, Wei Chen, Bingyong Mao, Shumao Cui
pmc-13504240.description: This study aimed to investigate the effect of sulforaphane‐producing Lacticaseibacillus paracasei CCFM1221 on the hepatoprotective efficacy of broccoli seed extract (BSE) in lipopolysaccharide (LPS)‐treated mice. The results indicate that L. paracasei CCFM1221 exhibits a high metabolic capacity for glucoraphanin. The co‐administration of L.

pmc-13554061.title: Natural variation in BRN1 enhances nitrogen sensitivity to improve rice nitrogen use efficiency
pmc-13554061.creator: Huwei Sun, Yake Chen, Yibo Hu, Hanyun Wang, Wenjun Zhu, Yuqing Liu, Ningning Ren, Bin Hu, Chengcai Chu
pmc-13554061.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Green Revolution rice varieties deliver high yields but require excessive nitrogen (N) fertilizer and show diminished N responsiveness, severely reducing nitrogen-use efficiency (NUE). To dissect the molecular basis of low N sensitivity in modern cultivars, we conducted a genome-wide association study (GWAS) for biomass response to N (BRN), a trait tightly linked to N sensitivity, using a diverse rice germplasm panel. We identified BRN1 as a key regulator of N-dependent biomass accumulation that regulates NLP3, a master transcription factor governing nitrate signaling.

pmc-13636446.title: Integrated multi-tissue transcriptomic analysis identifies hub genes associated with egg production recovery after fasting-induced molting
pmc-13636446.creator: Xiaomeng Miao, Jia Liu, Fugui Li, Xing Chen, Yimin Wei, Li Zhang, Yulong Feng, Zhonghua Ning
pmc-13636446.description: Fasting-induced molting is widely employed in the poultry industry to rejuvenate the reproductive system of aging laying hens, thereby improving post-molt laying performance and extending productive lifespan. However, substantial individual variation in post-molt reproductive recovery may compromise the overall effectiveness of molting programs. Elucidating the molecular basis underlying this variation is therefore important for poultry production and genetic improvement.
